repo.description: A flexible and high-performance training framework designed for large-scale foundation model training on AMD GPUs
repo.name: Primus

detail.body:
## Summary

- Add Flux.1-dev, SDXL, Mochi-1, HunyuanVideo, and Wan2.1-I2V post-training workloads to Primus, registered under `primus/backends/diffusion/amdb_benchmarks` with MI300X, MI325X, and MI355X configs.
- Time only the denoiser step. Each rank encodes its shard once before the timed loop, matching AMDiffusionBenchmark. Host decode, bf16 frozen encoders, fused Flux RoPE, and MIOpen find mode 5 stay on these benchmark paths and off the existing Flux and Wan trainers.
- Match the AMDB training loss. Wan trains on the raw VAE sample, with only the image-to-video condition normalized. Mochi and Hunyuan use AMDB's flow-matching target. Gradient checkpointing is off for Mochi and Hunyuan on MI300X and MI325X.

## How to run

From a writable directory, on one node:

```bash
cd /workspace/Primus
./primus-cli direct -- train posttrain --config examples/diffusion/configs/MI300X/benchmark_flux_dev-posttrain.yaml
```

Swap the config for `benchmark_sdxl`, `benchmark_mochi_1`, `benchmark_hunyuan_video`, or `benchmark_wan2_1_i2v`. Defaults are 100 steps (SDXL 200), local batch 1, learning rate `1e-5`, and seed 42. `cache_latents: false` restores online VAE and text encoding inside the step.

## MI300X, 8x GPU, steady state after step 5

| Model | AMDB fps | Primus fps | AMDB TFLOPS/s | Primus TFLOPS/s | Loss, last 10 steps, AMDB → Primus |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| FLUX.1-dev | 4.19 | 5.24 | 273.5 | 312.2 | 0.40 → 0.41 |
| SDXL | 12.82 | 14.19 | 229.1 | 253.7 | 0.24 → 0.24 |
| Mochi-1 | 1.04 | 1.20 | 140.9 | 163.5 | 0.53 → 0.61 |
| HunyuanVideo | 0.68 | 0.72 | 176.7 | 187.1 | 0.16 → 0.14 |
| Wan2.1 I2V | 0.33 | 0.40 | 250.9 | 244.7 | 0.19 → 0.15 |

fps is the comparison to use. TFLOPS/s divides a first-step flop count by the step time, and the two counters do not count the same attention work on Flux, SDXL, and Wan. Mochi ends higher because the official denoiser and the Diffusers denoiser do not take the same steps. Wan step 1 is still higher (4.94 against 3.55) because the two VAEs do not draw the same sample. Both end on the same scale.

## Test plan

- [ ] `python -m pytest primus/backends/diffusion/test_benchmark_workloads.py`
- [ ] Flux, SDXL, Mochi, Hunyuan, and Wan each finish the configured step count on 8x MI300X.
- [ ] A step log line contains `step_loss`, `train_loss`, `fps_gpu`, and `tflops/s`.

@@ -117,3 +117,56 @@ python3 runner/helpers/hooks/train/pretrain/diffusion/prepare.py \
 ```
 
 On success the hook prints `env.PREPARED=1`.
+
+## Official-module post-training
+
+FLUX.1-dev, SDXL, Mochi-1, HunyuanVideo, and Wan2.1 I2V fine-tune the
+in-tree modules adapted from the official implementations. They do not build
+a Diffusers pipeline. Point `PRETRAINED_PATH` at the official DiT or UNet
+checkpoint.
+
+| Workload | Official source | Checkpoint |
+|---|---|---|
+| FLUX.1-dev | Black Forest Labs FLUX | `flux1-dev.safetensors`, T5-XXL, CLIP-L, `ae.safetensors` |
+| SDXL | Stability `generative-models` UNet | `sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors` plus the SDXL VAE |
+| Mochi-1 | Genmo `AsymmDiTJoint` and VAE encoder | official DiT and encoder safetensors, T5-XXL |
+| HunyuanVideo | Tencent `HYVideoDiffusionTransformer` | official transformer weights, LLaMA text encoder, CLIP-L |
+| Wan2.1 I2V 14B | Wan2.1 DiT with CLIP cross-attention | official I2V DiT, Wan2.1 VAE, UMT5, CLIP vision |
+
+HunyuanVideo's trainable module is the transformer. Its causal 3D VAE is not
+vendored. A snapshot that contains `vae/` is used to encode raw video; a
+latent batch trains without it. Mochi encodes video with the official VAE
+encoder. Wan2.1 I2V encodes with the existing Wan2.1 VAE and the vendored CLIP
+visual tower.
+
+MI355X configs default to learning rate `1e-4`, `constant_with_warmup`, and
+`max_grad_norm` 1.0. MI300X and MI325X keep the AMDB scheduler: flux and the
+video models use `1e-5` with a constant schedule, and SDXL uses `1e-4` with a
+polynomial schedule. `LR` overrides either default.
+
+Per-GPU batch sizes follow the AMDiffusionBenchmark MI300/MI325 and MI355 commands.
+`LOCAL_BATCH_SIZE` still overrides the default.
+
+| Workload | MI300X / MI325X | MI355X |
+|---|---:|---:|
+| flux-dev | 10 | 16 |
+| mochi-1 | 1 | 4 |
+| hunyuan-video | 1 | 3 |
+| stable-diffusion-xl | 20 | 12 |
+| wan2.1-i2v | 1 | 1 |
+
+```bash
+PRETRAINED_PATH=/models/sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors \
+VAE_CHECKPOINT=/models/sdxl_vae.safetensors \
+MAX_STEPS=10 \
+./primus-cli direct -- train posttrain \
+  --config examples/diffusion/configs/MI355X/benchmark_sdxl-posttrain.yaml
+```
+
+Use `examples/diffusion/configs/MI300X` or `MI325X` on those GPUs. Swap the
+config for `benchmark_mochi_1`, `benchmark_hunyuan_video`, or
+`benchmark_wan2_1_i2v`. Video presets default to 9 frames. Keep `SP_SIZE` at 1.
+
+`benchmark_flux_dev-posttrain.yaml` fine-tunes the native FLUX.1-dev module.
+Set `PRETRAINED_PATH` to `flux1-dev.safetensors` and `VAE_CHECKPOINT` to
+`ae.safetensors`.

+work_group: ${PRIMUS_TEAM:local}
+user_name: ${PRIMUS_USER:local}
+exp_name: ${PRIMUS_EXP_NAME:benchmark-flux-dev-posttrain}
+workspace: ${PRIMUS_WORKSPACE:./output}
+
+# MIOpen's own default (dynamic hybrid). The runner exports FAST (2), which
+# skips the solver search and picks slower VAE and UNet convolutions.
+env:
+  MIOPEN_FIND_MODE: "5"
+  PRIMUS_FLUX_TRITON_ROPE: "1"
+
+platform:
+  config: platform_local.yaml
+
+modules:
+  post_trainer:
+    framework: diffusion
+    config: post_trainer.yaml
+
+    model: benchmark_flux_dev.yaml
+    overrides:
+      sink_level: null
+      file_sink_level: INFO
+      stderr_sink_level: INFO
+
+      metrics:
+        log_freq: 1
+        enable_wandb: false
+
+      training:
+        local_batch_size: ${LOCAL_BATCH_SIZE:10}
+        steps: ${MAX_STEPS:100}
+        num_train_epochs: 1000
+        gradient_accumulation_steps: 1
+        output_dir: ${OUTPUT_DIR:./output/benchmark-flux-dev-posttrain}
+        save_steps: 0
+        run_name: benchmark-flux-dev-posttrain
+
+      data:
+        dataset_path: ${DATASET_PATH:frank-chieng/chinese_architecture_siheyuan}
+        dataset_type: ${DATASET_TYPE:raw}
+        modality: image
+
+      parallelism:
+        sp_size: 1
+
+      runtime:
+        attention_backend: flash_attn_aiter
+        gradient_checkpointing: false

+        "per_device_train_batch_size": 1,

+        "warmup_steps": 0,

+        "num_train_epochs": 1,
+        "max_steps": 100,
+        "logging_steps": 1,
+        "save_steps": 0,
+        "save_total_limit": 3,
+        "dataloader_num_workers": 0,
+        # AMDiffusionBenchmark uses Accelerator(even_batches=True): a short tail

+        "dataloader_even_batches": True,
+        "report_to": "none",
+        "run_name": "amdb",
+        "bf16": True,

+        "dp_replicate": 1,
+    },
+}
+
+_SPECS: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
+    "sdxl": {
+        "modality": "image",
+        "fsdp_layers": "BasicTransformerBlock",
+        "learning_rate": 1.0e-4,
+        "lr_scheduler_type": "polynomial",
+        # Shorter than the default ``max_steps`` so a builder-only run leaves warmup.
+        # The MI300X and MI325X configs still set warmup_steps to 100.
+        "warmup_steps": 10,
+        "gradient_checkpointing": False,
+    },
+    "mochi-1": {
+        "modality": "video",
+        "fsdp_layers": "AsymmetricJointBlock",
+        "learning_rate": 1.0e-5,
+        "lr_scheduler_type": "constant",
+        "warmup_steps": 0,
+        "gradient_checkpointing": False,
+    },
+    "hunyuan-video": {
+        "modality": "video",
+        "fsdp_layers": "MMDoubleStreamBlock,MMSingleStreamBlock",
+        "learning_rate": 1.0e-5,
+        "lr_scheduler_type": "constant",
+        "warmup_steps": 0,
+        # Off on MI300X, MI325X, and MI355X. The 13B run stays inside memory at
+        # batch 1, and checkpointing would change the AMDB step time.
+        "gradient_checkpointing": False,
+    },
+    "wan2.1-i2v": {
+        "modality": "video",
+        "fsdp_layers": "DiTBlock",
+        "learning_rate": 1.0e-5,
+        "lr_scheduler_type": "constant",
+        "warmup_steps": 0,
+        "gradient_checkpointing": True,
+    },

+
+
+def _spec(model_name: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    if model_name == "stable-diffusion-xl":
+        model_name = "sdxl"
+    return _SPECS.get(model_name)
+
+
+def benchmark_defaults(
+    model_name: str,
+    *,
+    flux_dataset: dict[str, Any],
+    flux_trainer: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]] | None:
+    if model_name == "flux-dev":
+        dataset = copy.deepcopy(flux_dataset)
+        dataset["config"]["dataset_type"] = "raw"
+        dataset["config"]["dataset_format"] = "hf_repo"
+        dataset["config"]["dataset_path"] = ""
+        processor = dataset["config"]["processor_config"]
+        processor["img_size"] = 512
+        processor["processor_name"] = "flux_raw"
+        processor["processor_type"] = "flux_raw"
+        processor["skip_low_resolution"] = False
+        dataset["config"]["benchmark_loader"] = True
+        trainer = copy.deepcopy(BENCHMARK_TRAINER)
+        trainer["args"]["run_name"] = "flux-dev"
+        trainer["args"]["fsdp_transformer_layer_cls_to_wrap"] = "DoubleStreamBlock,SingleStreamBlock"
+        trainer["args"]["fsdp_module_paths_to_wrap"] = flux_trainer["args"]["fsdp_module_paths_to_wrap"]
+        trainer["args"]["fsdp_module_paths_no_reshard"] = flux_trainer["args"]["fsdp_module_paths_no_reshard"]
+        return dataset, trainer
+
+    spec = _spec(model_name)
+    if spec is None:
+        return None
+    dataset = {
+        "name": "amdb",
+        "config": {
+            "dataset_path": "",
+            "modality": spec["modality"],
+            "max_train_samples": -1,
+            "split": "train",
+        },
+    }
+    trainer = copy.deepcopy(BENCHMARK_TRAINER)
+    trainer["args"]["learning_rate"] = spec["learning_rate"]
+    trainer["args"]["lr_scheduler_type"] = spec["lr_scheduler_type"]
+    trainer["args"]["warmup_steps"] = spec["warmup_steps"]
+    trainer["args"]["gradient_checkpointing"] = spec["gradient_checkpointing"]
+    trainer["args"]["fsdp_transformer_layer_cls_to_wrap"] = spec["fsdp_layers"]
+    trainer["args"]["run_name"] = model_name
+    return dataset, trainer
+
+
+def apply_benchmark_sections(
+    model_name: str,
+    *,
+    data: dict[str, Any],
+    trainer_args: dict[str, Any],
+    dataset_cfg: dict[str, Any],
+    normalized: dict[str, Any],
+) -> None:
+    if model_name == "flux-dev":
+        if str(data.get("dataset_type", "")).lower() == "precomputed":
+            normalized["dataset"]["name"] = "amdb"
+            dataset_cfg["modality"] = "image"
+        resolution = data.get("resolution")
+        model_cfg = normalized["model"].get("config")
+        if resolution is None and isinstance(model_cfg, dict):
+            resolution = model_cfg.get("resolution")
+        if resolution is not None:
+            size = int(str(resolution).split(",")[0])
+            processor = dataset_cfg.setdefault("processor_config", {})

+        return
+    if int(trainer_args.get("sp_size", 1)) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"{model_name} diffusion training requires `parallelism.sp_size: 1`.")
+    dataset_cfg["modality"] = data.get("modality") or spec["modality"]
+    for key in ("max_train_samples", "revision", "split"):
+        if data.get(key) is not None:
+            dataset_cfg[key] = data[key]
+    model_cfg = normalized["model"].setdefault("config", {})
+    if isinstance(model_cfg, dict):
+        for key in ("resolution", "num_frames", "center_crop", "shift"):
+            if data.get(key) is not None:
+                model_cfg[key] = data[key]

+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.attn\.norm_k\.", r"\1.img_attn_k_norm."),
+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.attn\.to_out\.0\.", r"\1.img_attn_proj."),
+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.attn\.norm_added_q\.", r"\1.txt_attn_q_norm."),
+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.attn\.norm_added_k\.", r"\1.txt_attn_k_norm."),
+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.attn\.to_add_out\.", r"\1.txt_attn_proj."),
+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.ff\.net\.0\.proj\.", r"\1.img_mlp.fc1."),
+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.ff\.net\.2\.", r"\1.img_mlp.fc2."),
+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.ff_context\.net\.0\.proj\.", r"\1.txt_mlp.fc1."),
+    (r"(double_blocks\.\d+)\.ff_context\.net\.2\.", r"\1.txt_mlp.fc2."),
+    (r"^single_transformer_blocks\.", "single_blocks."),
+    (r"(single_blocks\.\d+)\.attn\.norm_q\.", r"\1.q_norm."),
+    (r"(single_blocks\.\d+)\.attn\.norm_k\.", r"\1.k_norm."),
+    (r"(single_blocks\.\d+)\.norm\.linear\.", r"\1.modulation.linear."),
+    (r"(single_blocks\.\d+)\.proj_out\.", r"\1.linear2."),
+    (r"^proj_out\.", "final_layer.linear."),
+]
+
+
+def _swap_halves(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    first, second = tensor.chunk(2, dim=0)
+    return torch.cat([second, first], dim=0)
+
+
+def hunyuan_diffusers_to_native(state: dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    out: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    fused: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = {}
+    for key, value in state.items():
+        if key.startswith("norm_out.linear."):
+            # Diffusers stores the final AdaLN as (scale, shift); HunyuanVideo uses (shift, scale).
+            out["final_layer.adaLN_modulation.1." + key.rsplit(".", 1)[1]] = _swap_halves(value)
+            continue
+        native = _rename(key, _HUNYUAN_RULES)
+        match = re.match(
+            r"^(double_blocks\.\d+|single_blocks\.\d+|txt_in\.individual_token_refiner\.blocks\.\d+)\."
+            r"(?:attn\.)?(to_q|to_k|to_v|add_q_proj|add_k_proj|add_v_proj|proj_mlp)\.(weight|bias)$",
+            native,
+        )
+        if match is None:
+            out[native] = value
+            continue
+        prefix, part, param = match.groups()
+        if prefix.startswith("double_blocks"):
+            target = "img_attn_qkv" if part.startswith("to_") else "txt_attn_qkv"
+        elif prefix.startswith("single_blocks"):
+            target = "linear1"
+        else:
+            target = "self_attn_qkv"
+        fused.setdefault((f"{prefix}.{target}", param), {})[part] = value
+    for (target, param), parts in fused.items():
+        if target.endswith("linear1"):
+            order = ("to_q", "to_k", "to_v", "proj_mlp")
+        elif target.endswith("txt_attn_qkv"):
+            order = ("add_q_proj", "add_k_proj", "add_v_proj")
+        else:
+            order = ("to_q", "to_k", "to_v")
+        out[f"{target}.{param}"] = torch.cat([parts[name] for name in order], dim=0)
+    return out
+
+
+def is_diffusers_wan(state: dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> bool:
+    return "condition_embedder.time_proj.weight" in state
+
+
+_WAN_RULES = [
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.time_embedder\.linear_1\.", "time_embedding.0."),
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.time_embedder\.linear_2\.", "time_embedding.2."),
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.text_embedder\.linear_1\.", "text_embedding.0."),
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.text_embedder\.linear_2\.", "text_embedding.2."),
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.time_proj\.", "time_projection.1."),
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.image_embedder\.norm1\.", "img_emb.proj.0."),
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.image_embedder\.ff\.net\.0\.proj\.", "img_emb.proj.1."),
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.image_embedder\.ff\.net\.2\.", "img_emb.proj.3."),
+    (r"^condition_embedder\.image_embedder\.norm2\.", "img_emb.proj.4."),
+    (r"^scale_shift_table$", "head.modulation"),
+    (r"^proj_out\.", "head.head."),
+    (r"\.scale_shift_table$", ".modulation"),
+    (r"\.attn1\.to_q\.", ".self_attn.q."),
+    (r"\.attn1\.to_k\.", ".self_attn.k."),
+    (r"\.attn1\.to_v\.", ".self_attn.v."),
+    (r"\.attn1\.to_out\.0\.", ".self_attn.o."),
+    (r"\.attn1\.norm_", ".self_attn.norm_"),
+    (r"\.attn2\.to_q\.", ".cross_attn.q."),
+    (r"\.attn2\.to_k\.", ".cross_attn.k."),
+    (r"\.attn2\.to_v\.", ".cross_attn.v."),
+    (r"\.attn2\.to_out\.0\.", ".cross_attn.o."),
+    (r"\.attn2\.add_k_proj\.", ".cross_attn.k_img."),
+    (r"\.attn2\.add_v_proj\.", ".cross_attn.v_img."),
+    (r"\.attn2\.norm_added_k\.", ".cross_attn.norm_k_img."),
+    (r"\.attn2\.norm_", ".cross_attn.norm_"),
+    (r"\.norm2\.", ".norm3."),
+    (r"\.ffn\.net\.0\.proj\.", ".ffn.0."),
+    (r"\.ffn\.net\.2\.", ".ffn.2."),
+]
+
+
+def wan_diffusers_to_native(state: dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    out: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    for key, value in state.items():
+        # Diffusers keeps an (unused) Q norm for the image branch of cross attention.
+        if key.endswith(".attn2.norm_added_q.weight"):
+            continue
+        out[_rename(key, _WAN_RULES)] = value
+    return out

+"""Load official DiT / UNet state dicts from a file or a checkpoint directory."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import glob
+import os
+
+import torch
+from safetensors.torch import load_file as safe_load_file
+
+
+def load_state_dict(path: str) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    if os.path.isdir(path):
+        candidates = []
+        for pattern in ("*.safetensors", "*.pth", "*.pt", "*.bin", "*.ckpt"):
+            candidates.extend(sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(path, pattern))))
+        if not candidates:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No checkpoint files found under {path}")
+        merged: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        for candidate in candidates:
+            merged.update(load_state_dict(candidate))
+        return merged
+    if path.endswith(".safetensors"):
+        return dict(safe_load_file(path))
+    obj = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu")
+    if isinstance(obj, dict):
+        for key in ("state_dict", "model", "module"):
+            value = obj.get(key)
+            if isinstance(value, dict) and value and all(torch.is_tensor(item) for item in value.values()):
+                obj = value
+                break
+    if not isinstance(obj, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported checkpoint format at {path}")
+    return obj
+
+
+def strip_prefixes(state: dict[str, torch.Tensor], prefixes: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    out: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    for key, value in state.items():
+        stripped = key
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            for prefix in prefixes:
+                if stripped.startswith(prefix):
+                    stripped = stripped[len(prefix) :]
+                    changed = True
+        out[stripped] = value
+    return out
+
+
+def load_matching(module: torch.nn.Module, path: str, *, prefixes: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    if not path:
+        return 0, 0
+    state = strip_prefixes(load_state_dict(path), prefixes)
+    result = module.load_state_dict(state, strict=False)
+    return len(result.missing_keys), len(result.unexpected_keys)

+"""Hugging Face datasets used by the AMDiffusionBenchmark workloads."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import tempfile
+import zipfile
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from primus.backends.diffusion.data.collator import RawBatchCollator
+
+_DISNEY_VIDEO = "Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset"
+_SIHEYUAN = "chinese_architecture_siheyuan"
+_PROMPT_KEYS = ("prompt", "text", "caption", "txt", "caption_0")
+
+
+_IMAGE_SUFFIXES = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"}
+
+
+def is_siheyuan_dataset(dataset_path: str) -> bool:
+    text = str(dataset_path).replace("\\", "/")
+    local = Path(text).expanduser()
+    return _SIHEYUAN in text or (local.is_dir() and (local / "siheyuan.zip").is_file())
+
+
+def siheyuan_image_members(names: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    return sorted(
+        name for name in names if not name.endswith("/") and Path(name).suffix.lower() in _IMAGE_SUFFIXES
+    )
+
+
+def read_siheyuan_images(dataset_path: str) -> list[tuple[str, bytes]] | None:
+    """The 156-image train split: JPEGs from both archives, then the log PNGs.
+
+    ``load_dataset`` on this repo also yields npz, txt, and caption members, so
+    the decoded split is larger than the real training images.
+    """
+    local = Path(str(dataset_path)).expanduser()
+    if not local.is_dir() or not is_siheyuan_dataset(str(local)):
+        return None
+    rows: list[tuple[str, bytes]] = []
+    for archive_path in sorted(local.glob("*.zip")):
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
+            for name in siheyuan_image_members(archive.namelist()):
+                rows.append((name, archive.read(name)))
+    for path in sorted(local.rglob("*.png")):
+        rows.append((path.name, path.read_bytes()))
+    if not rows:
+        raise ValueError(f"{local} has no siheyuan train images")
+    return rows
+
+
+def load_benchmark_image_dataset(dataset_path: str):
+    """Load an image dataset. Siheyuan uses its 156-image train split."""
+    from datasets import Dataset, Image, load_dataset
+
+    images = read_siheyuan_images(dataset_path)
+    if images is not None:
+        records = {
+            "image": [{"path": name, "bytes": payload} for name, payload in images],
+            "caption": [Path(name).stem.replace("_", " ") for name, _payload in images],
+        }
+        return Dataset.from_dict(records).cast_column("image", Image())
+    return load_dataset(str(dataset_path), **image_dataset_load_kwargs(dataset_path))
+
+
+def image_dataset_load_kwargs(dataset_path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load arguments for a Hugging Face image dataset."""
+    del dataset_path
+    return {"split": "train", "verification_mode": "no_checks"}
+
+
+class _TemporaryVideoReader:
+    """decord reader that deletes its scratch file once the frames are taken."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str, reader: Any):
+        self._path = path
+        self._reader = reader
+
+    def get_batch(self, indices):
+        try:
+            return self._reader.get_batch(indices)
+        finally:
+            self.close()
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        path = self._path
+        self._path = None
+        if path:
+            try:
+                os.unlink(path)
+            except OSError:
+                pass
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._reader)
+
+    def __del__(self) -> None:
+        self.close()
+
+
+def open_video_reader(video: Any):
+    """Decode a Hugging Face video value with decord. This image has no torchcodec."""
+    if isinstance(video, str):
+        from decord import VideoReader, cpu
+
+        return VideoReader(video, ctx=cpu(0))
+    if not isinstance(video, dict) or "path" not in video and "bytes" not in video:
+        return video
+    from decord import VideoReader, cpu
+
+    source = video.get("path")
+    if source:
+        return VideoReader(str(source), ctx=cpu(0))
+    handle = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False)
+    try:
+        handle.write(video["bytes"])
+    finally:
+        handle.close()
+    return _TemporaryVideoReader(handle.name, VideoReader(handle.name, ctx=cpu(0)))
+
+
+def caption_from_image_filename(image: Any) -> str:
+    """Caption used by AMDiffusionBenchmark: the filename stem, underscores as spaces."""
+    filename = getattr(image, "filename", "") or ""
+    stem = Path(str(filename)).stem
+    return stem.replace("_", " ") if stem else ""
+
+
+class AMDBDataset:
+    """One sample of image or video plus an optional caption."""
+
+    def __init__(self, records: Any, *, modality: str):
+        if modality not in {"image", "video"}:
+            raise ValueError(f"amdb modality must be 'image' or 'video', got {modality!r}")
+        self.records = records
+        self.modality = modality
+        self._logged_skips: set[int] = set()
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.records)
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        count = len(self.records)
+        last_error: Exception | None = None
+        for offset in range(count):
+            row_index = (index + offset) % count
+            try:
+                return self._sample_from_row(self.records[row_index])
+            except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
+                last_error = exc
+                if row_index not in self._logged_skips:
+                    self._logged_skips.add(row_index)
+                    from primus.backends.diffusion.utils.log import logger
+
+                    logger.warning(
+                        "Skipping undecodable amdb %s sample %s: %s",
+                        self.modality,
+                        row_index,
+                        exc,
+                    )
+        raise RuntimeError(f"amdb dataset has no decodable {self.modality} sample") from last_error
+
+    def _sample_from_row(self, row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        sample: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        if self.modality == "image":
+            image = row["image"]
+            if hasattr(image, "load"):
+                image.load()
+            sample["image"] = image
+        else:
+            sample["video"] = open_video_reader(row["video"])
+        for key in _PROMPT_KEYS:
+            if key in row and row[key] is not None:
+                value = row[key]
+                sample["prompt"] = value[0] if isinstance(value, list) else str(value)
+                break
+        if "prompt" not in sample and self.modality == "image":
+            caption = caption_from_image_filename(sample.get("image"))
+            if caption:
+                sample["prompt"] = caption
+        return sample
+
+    def get_collator(self):
+        return RawBatchCollator()
+
+
+class AMDBProcessor:
+    """Group raw samples. The workload adapter tokenizes and transforms them."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config: dict[str, Any]):

+
+    def build(self):
+        return None
+
+    def prepare_batch(self, batch, device=None, dtype=None):

+        prompts = [sample.get("prompt", "") for sample in batch]
+        prepared: dict[str, Any] = {"prompts": prompts}
+        if batch and "image" in batch[0]:

+        if batch and "video" in batch[0]:

+                if key in {"prompt", "image", "video"} or not torch.is_tensor(value):

+def _load_saved_dataset(dataset_path: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]] | None:

+
+

+    modality = str(dataset_config.get("modality", "image"))

+    processor.build()
+    logger.info(f"Built amdb {modality} dataset with {len(dataset)} samples from {dataset_path}")
+    return dataset, processor
+
+
+class _CachedTensorDataset:
+    """Samples encoded from the AMDiffusionBenchmark source datasets."""
+
+    def __init__(self, samples: list[dict[str, Any]]):
+        if not samples:
+            raise ValueError("Cached benchmark dataset is empty")
+        self.samples = samples
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.samples)
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        sample = dict(self.samples[index])
+        if not sample.get("prompt"):
+            for key in _PROMPT_KEYS:
+                if sample.get(key):
+                    value = sample[key]
+                    sample["prompt"] = value[0] if isinstance(value, list) else str(value)
+                    break
+        video = sample.get("video")
+        if isinstance(video, str):
+            sample["video"] = open_video_reader(video)
+        return sample
+
+    def get_collator(self):
+        return RawBatchCollator()
+
+
+class _SyntheticDataset:
+    """Repeated denoiser batch at the AMDiffusionBenchmark latent shape."""
+
+    def __init__(self, count: int, sample: dict[str, torch.Tensor]):
+        self.count = count
+        self.sample = sample
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return self.count
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        del index
+        item: dict[str, Any] = {"prompt": "benchmark"}
+        item.update(self.sample)
+        return item
+
+    def get_collator(self):
+        return RawBatchCollator()
+
+
+def _synthetic_sample(kind: str) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    # Latent shapes follow the benchmark resolution after the official VAE:
+    # SDXL 1024 -> 4x128x128, video 960x544x9 -> spatial /8 and temporal /4
+    # (Mochi temporal reductions leave 2 frames).
+    if kind == "sdxl":
+        return {
+            "latents": torch.randn(4, 128, 128),
+            "context": torch.randn(77, 2048),
+            "pooled": torch.randn(1280),
+        }
+    if kind == "mochi":
+        return {
+            "latents": torch.randn(12, 2, 68, 120),
+            "text_hidden": torch.randn(256, 4096),
+            "text_mask": torch.ones(256, dtype=torch.bool),
+        }
+    if kind == "hunyuan":
+        return {
+            "latents": torch.randn(16, 3, 68, 120),
+            "text_states": torch.randn(256, 4096),
+            "text_mask": torch.ones(256, dtype=torch.long),
+            "text_states_2": torch.randn(768),
+        }
+    if kind == "wan":
+        return {
+            "latents": torch.randn(16, 3, 68, 120),
+            "context": torch.randn(512, 4096),
+            "y": torch.randn(20, 3, 68, 120),
+            "clip_fea": torch.randn(257, 1280),
+        }
+    raise ValueError(f"Unknown synthetic denoiser batch {kind!r}")

+processes start. Model repos land in ``<cache>/hub``. Dataset repos land in
+``<cache>/datasets/<org>/<name>``. The cache root is ``PRIMUS_HF_HOME`` when
+that is set. Otherwise an explicit ``HF_HOME`` is used, except when it equals
+the runner's automatic ``$DATA_PATH/huggingface``. The fallback is
+``~/cache/huggingface``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_MODEL_FILES: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {
+    "flux-dev": ("black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev", "flux1-dev.safetensors"),
+    "sdxl": ("stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0", "sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors"),
+    "stable-diffusion-xl": ("stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0", "sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors"),
+    "mochi-1": ("genmo/mochi-1-preview", "dit.safetensors"),
+    "hunyuan-video": ("hunyuanvideo-community/HunyuanVideo", "transformer"),
+    "wan2.1-i2v": ("Wan-AI/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-Diffusers", "transformer"),
+}
+_DATASETS: dict[str, tuple[str, str | None]] = {
+    "flux-dev": ("frank-chieng/chinese_architecture_siheyuan", None),
+    "sdxl": ("frank-chieng/chinese_architecture_siheyuan", None),
+    "stable-diffusion-xl": ("frank-chieng/chinese_architecture_siheyuan", None),
+    "mochi-1": ("Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset", "refs/pr/4"),
+    "hunyuan-video": ("Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset", "refs/pr/4"),
+    "wan2.1-i2v": ("Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset", "refs/pr/4"),
+}
+
+
+def _log(message: str) -> None:
+    print(f"[INFO] diffusion assets: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
+
+
+def huggingface_home() -> Path:
+    """Cache directory for benchmark downloads."""
+    requested = os.environ.get("PRIMUS_HF_HOME")
+    if requested:
+        return Path(requested).expanduser()
+    current = os.environ.get("HF_HOME")
+    data_path = os.environ.get("DATA_PATH")
+    automatic = str(Path(data_path) / "huggingface") if data_path else None
+    if current and current != automatic:
+        return Path(current).expanduser()
+    return Path.home() / "cache" / "huggingface"
+
+
+def dataset_root() -> Path:
+    """Folder that holds dataset repos, separate from the model hub cache."""
+    root = huggingface_home() / "datasets"
+    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return root
+
+
+def dataset_folder(repo_id: str) -> Path:
+    """Stable directory for one dataset repo: ``datasets/<org>/<name>``."""
+    return dataset_root() / repo_id
+
+
+def configure_huggingface_cache() -> Path:
+    """Point Hugging Face clients at the benchmark cache for this process."""
+    home = huggingface_home()
+    hub = home / "hub"
+    processed = home / "datasets-cache"
+    home.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    hub.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    dataset_root()
+    processed.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.environ["HF_HOME"] = str(home)
+    os.environ["HF_HUB_CACHE"] = str(hub)
+    os.environ["HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE"] = str(hub)
+    os.environ["HF_DATASETS_CACHE"] = str(processed)
+    _link_existing_token(home)
+    return home
+
+
+def cache_env() -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Environment lines the prepare hook exports to the training processes."""
+    home = configure_huggingface_cache()
+    return {
+        "HF_HOME": str(home),
+        "HF_HUB_CACHE": str(home / "hub"),
+        "HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE": str(home / "hub"),
+        "HF_DATASETS_CACHE": str(home / "datasets-cache"),
+    }
+
+
+def _link_existing_token(home: Path) -> None:
+    """Use an existing ``~/.hf_token`` without copying or printing it."""
+    destination = home / "token"
+    source = Path.home() / ".hf_token"
+    if destination.exists() or destination.is_symlink() or not source.is_file():
+        return
+    destination.symlink_to(source)
+
+
+def _is_hf_repo(value: str) -> bool:
+    path = Path(value).expanduser()
+    if path.exists() or value.startswith(("/", "./", "../", "~")):
+        return False
+    parts = value.split("/")
+    if len(parts) < 2 or not all(parts[:2]):
+        return False
+    return not parts[-1].endswith((".safetensors", ".bin", ".pt", ".pth", ".ckpt"))
+
+
+def _snapshot(
+    repo_id: str,
+    *,
+    revision: str | None = None,
+    allow_patterns: list[str] | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+
+    home = configure_huggingface_cache()
+    _log(f"Downloading {repo_id} (model) into {home / 'hub'}")
+    kwargs: dict[str, object] = {"repo_id": repo_id, "cache_dir": str(home / "hub")}
+    if revision:
+        kwargs["revision"] = revision
+    if allow_patterns:
+        kwargs["allow_patterns"] = allow_patterns
+    return snapshot_download(**kwargs)
+
+
+def _snapshot_dataset(repo_id: str, *, revision: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Download a dataset repo into ``datasets/<org>/<name>``, not the model hub."""
+    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+
+    configure_huggingface_cache()
+    local_dir = dataset_folder(repo_id)
+    local_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    blob_cache = dataset_root() / ".hub"
+    blob_cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    _log(f"Downloading {repo_id} (dataset) into {local_dir}")
+    kwargs: dict[str, str] = {
+        "repo_id": repo_id,
+        "repo_type": "dataset",
+        "cache_dir": str(blob_cache),
+        "local_dir": str(local_dir),
+    }
+    if revision:
+        kwargs["revision"] = revision
+    snapshot_download(**kwargs)
+    return str(local_dir)
+
+
+def materialize_pretrained(model_name: str, pretrained: str | None) -> str:
+    """Return a local checkpoint path, downloading the official repo when needed."""
+    spec = _MODEL_FILES.get(model_name)
+    if spec is None:
+        return str(pretrained or "")
+    default_repo, relative = spec
+    text = str(pretrained or "").strip()
+    local = Path(text).expanduser() if text else None
+    if local is not None and local.exists():
+        return str(local)
+    repo_id = default_repo
+    filename = relative
+    remote_file = text.count("/") >= 2 and not text.startswith(("/", ".", "~"))
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        repo_id = text
+    elif remote_file:
+        org, _, remainder = text.partition("/")
+        name, _, filename = remainder.partition("/")
+        repo_id = f"{org}/{name}"
+        filename = filename or relative
+    elif text:
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{model_name} checkpoint does not exist: {text}")
+    snapshot = _snapshot(repo_id)
+    target = Path(snapshot) / filename
+    if not target.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{repo_id} has no {filename} in {snapshot}")
+    _log(f"{model_name} checkpoint: {target}")
+    return str(target)
+
+
+def materialize_dataset(model_name: str, dataset_path: str | None, revision: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Return a local dataset directory, downloading the repo when needed."""
+    default = _DATASETS.get(model_name)
+    text = str(dataset_path or "").strip()
+    if text.startswith("synthetic:") or text.endswith(".pt"):
+        return text
+    local = Path(text).expanduser() if text else None
+    if local is not None and local.exists():
+        return str(local)
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        repo_id = text
+        rev = revision
+    elif not text and default is not None:
+        repo_id, rev = default
+    else:
+        return text
+    if repo_id == "Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset" and not rev:
+        rev = "refs/pr/4"
+    return _snapshot_dataset(repo_id, revision=rev)
+
+
+def prefetch_huggingface_repo(value: str | None) -> None:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        _snapshot(text)
+
+
+def _blank(value: object) -> bool:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    return not text or text.startswith("/path/to/")
+
+
+def _checkpoint_root(weights: str) -> Path:
+    path = Path(weights)
+    if path.is_file() or path.name == "transformer":
+        return path.parent
+    return path
+
+
+def tokenizer_dir(model_path: str) -> str:
+    """Tokenizer folder for a downloaded text encoder.
+
+    Diffusers snapshots keep ``tokenizer/`` next to ``text_encoder/``.
+    """
+    path = Path(model_path)
+    if (path / "tokenizer_config.json").is_file():
+        return str(path)
+    sibling = path.parent / "tokenizer"
+    if (sibling / "tokenizer_config.json").is_file():
+        return str(sibling)
+    return str(path)
+
+
+def _require_file(path: Path, description: str) -> str:
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{description} was not in the downloaded snapshot: {path}")
+    return str(path)
+
+
+def _companion_paths(model_name: str, weights: str, encoder: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Local encoder files that belong to the downloaded checkpoint."""
+    if not weights:
+        return {}
+    root = _checkpoint_root(weights)
+    found: dict[str, str] = {}
+    if model_name == "flux-dev" and _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")):
+        found["VAE_CHECKPOINT"] = _require_file(root / "ae.safetensors", "FLUX autoencoder")
+    elif model_name in {"sdxl", "stable-diffusion-xl"} and _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")):
+        vae = Path(weights) if Path(weights).is_file() else root / "sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors"
+        found["VAE_CHECKPOINT"] = _require_file(vae, "SDXL autoencoder")
+    elif model_name == "mochi-1" and _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")):
+        found["VAE_CHECKPOINT"] = _require_file(root / "encoder.safetensors", "Mochi VAE encoder")
+    elif model_name == "hunyuan-video":
+        if _blank(encoder.get("llm")):
+            found["LLM_ENCODER"] = _require_file(root / "text_encoder", "HunyuanVideo LLaMA encoder")
+        # The community snapshot sometimes ships ``vae/`` and sometimes does not.
+        # Latent batches do not need it; raw video does, and the caller can set
+        # ``encoder.autoencoder`` when the folder lives somewhere else.
+        if _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")) and (root / "vae").exists():
+            found["VAE_CHECKPOINT"] = str(root / "vae")
+    elif model_name == "wan2.1-i2v":
+        needed = {
+            "TEXT_ENCODER": "t5_encoder",
+            "VAE_CHECKPOINT": "autoencoder",
+            "CLIP_CHECKPOINT": "image_encoder",
+        }
+        if any(_blank(encoder.get(key)) for key in needed.values()):
+            snapshot = _snapshot(
+                "Wan-AI/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P",
+                allow_patterns=[
+                    "Wan2.1_VAE.pth",
+                    "models_t5_umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.pth",
+                    "models_clip_open-clip-xlm-roberta-large-vit-huge-14.pth",
+                ],
+            )
+            files = {
+                "TEXT_ENCODER": Path(snapshot) / "models_t5_umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.pth",
+                "VAE_CHECKPOINT": Path(snapshot) / "Wan2.1_VAE.pth",
+                "CLIP_CHECKPOINT": Path(snapshot) / "models_clip_open-clip-xlm-roberta-large-vit-huge-14.pth",
+            }
+            for env_key, cfg_key in needed.items():
+                if _blank(encoder.get(cfg_key)):
+                    found[env_key] = _require_file(files[env_key], env_key)
+    return found
+
+
+_ENCODER_ENV_KEYS = {
+    "VAE_CHECKPOINT": "autoencoder",
+    "LLM_ENCODER": "llm",
+    "TEXT_ENCODER": "t5_encoder",
+    "CLIP_CHECKPOINT": "image_encoder",
+}
+
+
+def _replace_with_download(value: str | None) -> bool:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    return not text or text.startswith("/path/to/") or _is_hf_repo(text)
+
+
+def stage_benchmark_assets(
+    model_name: str,
+    *,
+    dataset_path: str | None,
+    pretrained: str | None,
+    revision: str | None = None,
+    encoder: dict[str, object] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Download benchmark weights and the dataset, and return env exports."""
+    env = cache_env()
+    encoder = dict(encoder or {})
+    weights = materialize_pretrained(model_name, pretrained)
+    if weights and _replace_with_download(pretrained):
+        env["PRETRAINED_PATH"] = weights
+    data = materialize_dataset(model_name, dataset_path, revision=revision)
+    if data and data != str(dataset_path or "").strip() and _replace_with_download(dataset_path):
+        env["DATASET_PATH"] = data
+    if os.environ.get("BENCHMARK_DENOISER_ONLY") != "1":
+        env.update(_companion_paths(model_name, weights, encoder))
+        for value in encoder.values():
+            if isinstance(value, str):
+                prefetch_huggingface_repo(value)
+    return env

+
+"""Report fused attention FLOPs to ``torch.utils.flop_counter.FlopCounterMode``.
+
+Kernels such as AITER flash attention are opaque custom ops with no FLOP formula,
+so ``FlopCounterMode`` counts them as zero. That is also what AMDiffusionBenchmark
+reports. The marker below can add the FLOPs of the equivalent
+``scaled_dot_product_attention`` call, but only when
+``PRIMUS_COUNT_ATTENTION_FLOPS=1``. It stays off by default so benchmark TFLOPS
+match AMDiffusionBenchmark.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+import torch
+from torch.utils._python_dispatch import _get_current_dispatch_mode_stack
+from torch.utils.flop_counter import (
+    register_flop_formula,
+    sdpa_backward_flop_count,
+    sdpa_flop_count,
+)
+
+
+@torch.library.custom_op("primus_diffusion::attention_flops", mutates_args=())
+def _attention_flops(anchor: torch.Tensor, flops: int) -> None:
+    return None
+
+
+@_attention_flops.register_fake
+def _(anchor, flops):
+    return None
+
+
+@register_flop_formula(torch.ops.primus_diffusion.attention_flops)
+def _attention_flops_formula(anchor_shape, flops, *args, out_shape=None, **kwargs) -> int:
+    return int(flops)
+
+
+def flop_counter_active() -> bool:
+    return any(type(mode).__name__ == "_FlopCounterMode" for mode in _get_current_dispatch_mode_stack())
+
+
+def count_attention_flops() -> bool:
+    return os.environ.get("PRIMUS_COUNT_ATTENTION_FLOPS", "0") == "1"
+
+
+class _BackwardFlops(torch.autograd.Function):
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, x, flops):
+        ctx.flops = flops
+        return x.view_as(x)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, grad):
+        torch.ops.primus_diffusion.attention_flops(grad, ctx.flops)
+        return grad, None
+
+
+def mark_attention_flops(
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    qk_pairs: int,
+    v_head_dim: int | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Attribute SDPA-equivalent FLOPs for ``qk_pairs`` = sum over sequences of ``len_q * len_k``."""
+    if not flop_counter_active() or not count_attention_flops():
+        return out
+    dv = head_dim if v_head_dim is None else v_head_dim
+    q_shape, k_shape, v_shape = (1, heads, qk_pairs, head_dim), (1, heads, 1, head_dim), (1, heads, 1, dv)
+    torch.ops.primus_diffusion.attention_flops(out, sdpa_flop_count(q_shape, k_shape, v_shape))
+    if not (torch.is_grad_enabled() and out.requires_grad):
+        return out
+    bwd = sdpa_backward_flop_count((1, heads, qk_pairs, dv), q_shape, k_shape, v_shape)
+    return _BackwardFlops.apply(out, bwd)
+
+
+def varlen_qk_pairs(cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor, cu_seqlens_k: torch.Tensor) -> int:
+    q_lens = cu_seqlens_q.diff().tolist()
+    k_lens = cu_seqlens_k.diff().tolist()
+    return int(sum(lq * lk for lq, lk in zip(q_lens, k_lens, strict=True)))

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass

+
+import torch

+
+from primus.backends.diffusion.amdb_benchmarks.flux.train_pipeline import (
+    FluxFlowMatchTrainPipeline,
+)

+
+
+@dataclass
+class FluxConfigShim:
+    raw: dict
+
+    def save_pretrained(self, save_directory: str):
+        import json
+        import os
+
+        os.makedirs(save_directory, exist_ok=True)
+        with open(os.path.join(save_directory, "flux_config.json"), "w") as f:
+            json.dump(self.raw, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+
+    def to_dict(self):
+        return self.raw
+
+
+class FluxForTraining(GenAIModel, nn.Module):
+    """Thin Primus adapter around the FLUX DiT backbone."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        dit: nn.Module,
+        train_pipeline: FluxFlowMatchTrainPipeline,
+        model_config: Any,
+        autoencoder: nn.Module | None = None,
+        t5_encoder: nn.Module | None = None,
+        clip_encoder: nn.Module | None = None,
+        raw_config: dict | None = None,
+        trainable_modules: str | None = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.dit = dit
+        self.autoencoder = autoencoder
+        self.t5_encoder = t5_encoder
+        self.clip_encoder = clip_encoder
+        self.train_pipeline = train_pipeline
+        self.model_config = model_config
+        self.trainable_modules = trainable_modules
+        self.compute_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None
+        self.config = FluxConfigShim(raw=raw_config or {})
+
+    @property
+    def device(self):
+        return next(self.parameters()).device
+
+    @property
+    def dtype(self):
+        return next(self.parameters()).dtype
+
+    def freeze_except(self):
+        mode = (
+            self.trainable_modules or getattr(self.model_config, "trainable_modules", None) or "dit"
+        ).lower()
+
+        def freeze(module: nn.Module):
+            for param in module.parameters():
+                param.requires_grad_(False)
+
+        def unfreeze(module: nn.Module):
+            for param in module.parameters():
+                param.requires_grad_(True)
+
+        freeze(self)
+        if mode in ("dit", "diffusion", "backbone"):
+            unfreeze(self.dit)
+        elif mode == "all":
+            unfreeze(self)
+        else:
+            unfreeze(self.dit)
+
+    def gradient_checkpointing_enable(self, gradient_checkpointing_kwargs=None):
+        if getattr(self.dit, "_torchtitan_checkpoint_wrapped", False):
+            return
+
+        ratio = float((gradient_checkpointing_kwargs or {}).get("ratio", 1.0))
+        if not 0.0 <= ratio <= 1.0:
+            raise ValueError(f"gradient_checkpointing_ratio must be in [0, 1], got {ratio}")
+
+        # Match the MLPerf TorchTitan reference: wrap each transformer block
+        # before FSDP and do not preserve RNG state. The older in-forward
+        # torch.utils.checkpoint path is not equivalent and is unstable when
+        # composed with FSDP2 on ROCm.
+        from torch.distributed.algorithms._checkpoint.checkpoint_wrapper import (
+            checkpoint_wrapper,
+        )
+
+        block_lists = [getattr(self.dit, name) for name in ("double_blocks", "single_blocks")]
+        checkpoint_count = round(sum(len(blocks) for blocks in block_lists) * ratio)
+        block_number = 0
+        for blocks in block_lists:
+            for index, block in enumerate(blocks):
+                if block_number >= checkpoint_count:
+                    break
+                blocks[index] = checkpoint_wrapper(block, preserve_rng_state=False)
+                block_number += 1
+        self.dit.gradient_checkpointing = False
+        self.dit._torchtitan_checkpoint_wrapped = True
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        if len(args) >= 1 and isinstance(args[0], dict):
+            scheduler = args[1] if len(args) >= 2 else kwargs.get("scheduler")
+            return self.forward_train(args[0], scheduler=scheduler)
+        raise TypeError("FluxForTraining.forward expects (batch_dict, scheduler)")
+
+    def encode_batch(self, batch: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        param = next(self.dit.parameters())
+        return self.train_pipeline.encode_batch(
+            batch=batch,
+            autoencoder=self.autoencoder,
+            t5_encoder=self.t5_encoder,
+            clip_encoder=self.clip_encoder,
+            device=param.device,
+            dtype=self.compute_dtype or param.dtype,
+        )
+
+    def offload_frozen_modules(self) -> None:
+        for module in (self.autoencoder, self.t5_encoder, self.clip_encoder):
+            if module is not None:
+                module.to("cpu")
+
+    def forward_train(self, batch: dict[str, Any], scheduler: Any = None) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        del scheduler
+        return self.train_pipeline.compute_loss(
+            dit=self.dit,
+            autoencoder=self.autoencoder,
+            t5_encoder=self.t5_encoder,
+            clip_encoder=self.clip_encoder,
+            batch=batch,
+            model_config=self.model_config,
+            compute_dtype=self.compute_dtype,
+        )
+
+    def forward_inference(self, batch: dict[str, Any], **kwargs):
+        raise NotImplementedError("FLUX inference pipeline is not wired for Primus training yet")

+class EmbedND(nn.Module):

+        super().__init__()
+        self.dim = dim
+        self.theta = theta

+    def forward(self, ids: Tensor) -> Tensor:

+def timestep_embedding(t: Tensor, dim: int, max_period: int = 10000, time_factor: float = 1000.0) -> Tensor:

+    half = dim // 2
+    freqs = torch.exp(
+        -math.log(max_period) * torch.arange(start=0, end=half, dtype=torch.float32, device=t.device) / half
+    )
+    args = t[:, None].float() * freqs[None]
+    embedding = torch.cat([torch.cos(args), torch.sin(args)], dim=-1)
+    if dim % 2:
+        embedding = torch.cat([embedding, torch.zeros_like(embedding[:, :1])], dim=-1)
+    if torch.is_floating_point(t):
+        embedding = embedding.to(t)
+    return embedding
+
+
+class MLPEmbedder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, in_dim: int, hidden_dim: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.in_layer = nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim, bias=True)
+        self.silu = nn.SiLU()
+        self.out_layer = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, bias=True)
+
+    def init_weights(self, init_std: float = 0.02) -> None:
+        nn.init.normal_(self.in_layer.weight, std=init_std)
+        nn.init.constant_(self.in_layer.bias, 0)
+        nn.init.normal_(self.out_layer.weight, std=init_std)
+        nn.init.constant_(self.out_layer.bias, 0)
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        return self.out_layer(self.silu(self.in_layer(x)))
+
+
+class RMSNorm(nn.RMSNorm):
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, eps: float | None = None):
+        # eps=None matches TorchTitan's nn.RMSNorm(dim), where PyTorch selects the
+        # epsilon for the BF16 input dtype at runtime. BFL/Diffusers FLUX use 1e-6
+        # with FP32 statistics.
+        super().__init__(dim, eps=eps)
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        if self.eps is None:
+            return super().forward(x)
+        x_dtype = x.dtype
+        rrms = torch.rsqrt(x.float().pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
+        return (x.float() * rrms).to(x_dtype) * self.weight
+
+
+class QKNorm(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, eps: float | None = None):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.query_norm = RMSNorm(dim, eps=eps)
+        self.key_norm = RMSNorm(dim, eps=eps)
+
+    def init_weights(self) -> None:
+        self.query_norm.reset_parameters()
+        self.key_norm.reset_parameters()
+
+    def forward(self, q: Tensor, k: Tensor, v: Tensor) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
+        q = self.query_norm(q)
+        k = self.key_norm(k)
+        return q.to(v), k.to(v)
+
+
+class SelfAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self, dim: int, num_heads: int = 8, qkv_bias: bool = False, qk_norm_eps: float | None = None
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_heads = num_heads
+        head_dim = dim // num_heads
+        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
+        self.norm = QKNorm(head_dim, eps=qk_norm_eps)
+        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
+
+    def init_weights(self) -> None:
+        for layer in (self.qkv, self.proj):
+            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight)
+            if layer.bias is not None:
+                nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
+        self.norm.init_weights()
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor, pe: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        qkv = self.qkv(x)
+        q, k, v = rearrange(qkv, "B L (K H D) -> K B L H D", K=3, H=self.num_heads)
+        q, k = self.norm(q, k, v)
+        x = attention(q, k, v, pe=pe)
+        return self.proj(x)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ModulationOut:
+    shift: Tensor
+    scale: Tensor
+    gate: Tensor
+
+
+class Modulation(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, double: bool):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.is_double = double
+        self.multiplier = 6 if double else 3
+        self.lin = nn.Linear(dim, self.multiplier * dim, bias=True)
+
+    def init_weights(self) -> None:
+        nn.init.constant_(self.lin.weight, 0)
+        nn.init.constant_(self.lin.bias, 0)
+
+    def forward(self, vec: Tensor) -> tuple[ModulationOut, ModulationOut | None]:
+        out = self.lin(nn.functional.silu(vec))[:, None, :].chunk(self.multiplier, dim=-1)
+        return ModulationOut(*out[:3]), ModulationOut(*out[3:]) if self.is_double else None
+
+
+class DoubleStreamBlock(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        num_heads: int,
+        mlp_ratio: float,
+        qkv_bias: bool = False,
+        qk_norm_eps: float | None = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        mlp_hidden_dim = int(hidden_size * mlp_ratio)
+        self.num_heads = num_heads
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.img_mod = Modulation(hidden_size, double=True)
+        self.img_norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
+        self.img_attn = SelfAttention(
+            dim=hidden_size, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, qk_norm_eps=qk_norm_eps
+        )
+        self.img_norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
+        self.img_mlp = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(hidden_size, mlp_hidden_dim, bias=True),
+            nn.GELU(approximate="tanh"),
+            nn.Linear(mlp_hidden_dim, hidden_size, bias=True),
+        )
+        self.txt_mod = Modulation(hidden_size, double=True)
+        self.txt_norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
+        self.txt_attn = SelfAttention(
+            dim=hidden_size, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, qk_norm_eps=qk_norm_eps
+        )
+        self.txt_norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
+        self.txt_mlp = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(hidden_size, mlp_hidden_dim, bias=True),
+            nn.GELU(approximate="tanh"),
+            nn.Linear(mlp_hidden_dim, hidden_size, bias=True),
+        )
+
+    def init_weights(self) -> None:
+        for layer in (self.img_mlp[0], self.img_mlp[2], self.txt_mlp[0], self.txt_mlp[2]):
+            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight)
+            nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
+        for layer in (self.img_attn, self.img_mod, self.txt_attn, self.txt_mod):
+            layer.init_weights()
+        for norm in (self.txt_norm1, self.txt_norm2, self.img_norm1, self.img_norm2):
+            norm.reset_parameters()
+
+    def forward(self, img: Tensor, txt: Tensor, vec: Tensor, pe: Tensor) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
+        img_mod1, img_mod2 = self.img_mod(vec)
+        txt_mod1, txt_mod2 = self.txt_mod(vec)
+
+        img_modulated = (1 + img_mod1.scale) * self.img_norm1(img) + img_mod1.shift
+        img_qkv = self.img_attn.qkv(img_modulated)
+        img_q, img_k, img_v = rearrange(img_qkv, "B L (K H D) -> K B L H D", K=3, H=self.num_heads)
+        img_q, img_k = self.img_attn.norm(img_q, img_k, img_v)
+
+        txt_modulated = (1 + txt_mod1.scale) * self.txt_norm1(txt) + txt_mod1.shift
+        txt_qkv = self.txt_attn.qkv(txt_modulated)
+        txt_q, txt_k, txt_v = rearrange(txt_qkv, "B L (K H D) -> K B L H D", K=3, H=self.num_heads)
+        txt_q, txt_k = self.txt_attn.norm(txt_q, txt_k, txt_v)
+
+        q = torch.cat((txt_q, img_q), dim=1)
+        k = torch.cat((txt_k, img_k), dim=1)
+        v = torch.cat((txt_v, img_v), dim=1)
+        attn = attention(q, k, v, pe=pe)
+        txt_attn, img_attn = attn[:, : txt.shape[1]], attn[:, txt.shape[1] :]
+
+        img = img + img_mod1.gate * self.img_attn.proj(img_attn)
+        img = img + img_mod2.gate * self.img_mlp((1 + img_mod2.scale) * self.img_norm2(img) + img_mod2.shift)
+        txt = txt + txt_mod1.gate * self.txt_attn.proj(txt_attn)
+        txt = txt + txt_mod2.gate * self.txt_mlp((1 + txt_mod2.scale) * self.txt_norm2(txt) + txt_mod2.shift)
+        return img, txt
+
+
+class SingleStreamBlock(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        num_heads: int,
+        mlp_ratio: float = 4.0,
+        qk_scale: float | None = None,
+        qk_norm_eps: float | None = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden_dim = hidden_size
+        self.num_heads = num_heads
+        head_dim = hidden_size // num_heads
+        self.scale = qk_scale or head_dim**-0.5
+        self.mlp_hidden_dim = int(hidden_size * mlp_ratio)
+        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size * 3 + self.mlp_hidden_dim)
+        self.linear2 = nn.Linear(hidden_size + self.mlp_hidden_dim, hidden_size)
+        self.norm = QKNorm(head_dim, eps=qk_norm_eps)
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.pre_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
+        self.mlp_act = nn.GELU(approximate="tanh")
+        self.modulation = Modulation(hidden_size, double=False)
+
+    def init_weights(self) -> None:
+        for layer in (self.linear1, self.linear2):
+            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight)
+            nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
+        self.norm.init_weights()
+        self.pre_norm.reset_parameters()
+        self.modulation.init_weights()
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor, vec: Tensor, pe: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        mod, _ = self.modulation(vec)
+        x_mod = (1 + mod.scale) * self.pre_norm(x) + mod.shift
+        qkv, mlp = torch.split(self.linear1(x_mod), [3 * self.hidden_size, self.mlp_hidden_dim], dim=-1)
+        q, k, v = rearrange(qkv, "B L (K H D) -> K B L H D", K=3, H=self.num_heads)
+        q, k = self.norm(q, k, v)
+        attn = attention(q, k, v, pe=pe)
+        output = self.linear2(torch.cat((attn, self.mlp_act(mlp)), 2))
+        return x + mod.gate * output
+
+
+class LastLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, patch_size: int, out_channels: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.norm_final = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
+        self.linear = nn.Linear(hidden_size, patch_size * patch_size * out_channels, bias=True)
+        self.adaLN_modulation = nn.Sequential(nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(hidden_size, 2 * hidden_size, bias=True))
+
+    def init_weights(self) -> None:
+        nn.init.constant_(self.adaLN_modulation[-1].weight, 0)
+        nn.init.constant_(self.adaLN_modulation[-1].bias, 0)
+        nn.init.constant_(self.linear.weight, 0)
+        nn.init.constant_(self.linear.bias, 0)
+        self.norm_final.reset_parameters()
+
+    def forward(self, x: Tensor, vec: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        shift, scale = self.adaLN_modulation(vec).chunk(2, dim=1)
+        x = (1 + scale[:, None, :]) * self.norm_final(x) + shift[:, None, :]
+        return self.linear(x)

+            )

+        self.vector_in.init_weights(init_std=0.02)

+        for block in self.single_blocks:

+        for block in self.double_blocks:

+    def _checkpoint_double(self, block: nn.Module, img: Tensor, txt: Tensor, vec: Tensor, pe: Tensor):
+        import torch.utils.checkpoint as checkpoint_utils

+        return checkpoint_utils.checkpoint(block, img, txt, vec, pe, use_reentrant=False)

+        import torch.utils.checkpoint as checkpoint_utils

+        return checkpoint_utils.checkpoint(block, img, vec, pe, use_reentrant=False)

+    def forward(
+        self,
+        img: Tensor,
+        img_ids: Tensor,

+        txt_ids: Tensor,

+            else:

+def _strip_known_prefixes(state_dict: dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    prefixes = ("module.", "dit.", "model.")
+    out: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    for key, value in state_dict.items():
+        stripped = key
+        changed = True
+        while changed:
+            changed = False
+            for prefix in prefixes:
+                if stripped.startswith(prefix):
+                    stripped = stripped[len(prefix) :]
+                    changed = True
+        out[stripped] = value
+    return out
+

+def _load_state_dict(path: str) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    if path.endswith(".safetensors"):
+        return dict(safe_load_file(path))
+    obj = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu")
+    if isinstance(obj, dict) and "model" in obj and isinstance(obj["model"], dict):
+        obj = obj["model"]
+    if not isinstance(obj, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported checkpoint format at {path}")
+    return obj
+

+def _candidate_weight_files(path: str, *, default_filename: str) -> list[str]:
+    if os.path.isfile(path):
+        return [path]
+    if not os.path.exists(path):
+        resolved = _resolve_hf_checkpoint(path, default_filename=default_filename)
+        if resolved:
+            return [resolved]
+    candidates: list[str] = []
+    for fname in (
+        "flux1-schnell.safetensors",
+        "flux1-dev.safetensors",
+        "dit_model.safetensors",
+        "model.safetensors",
+    ):
+        candidate = os.path.join(path, fname)
+        if os.path.exists(candidate):
+            candidates.append(candidate)
+    if not candidates:
+        candidates = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(path, "*.safetensors")))
+    if not candidates:
+        candidates = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(path, "*.bin")))
+    return candidates
+
+
+def _resolve_hf_checkpoint(path_or_repo_file: str, *, default_filename: str) -> str | None:
+    if path_or_repo_file.startswith(("/", "./", "../", "~")):
+        return None
+    parts = path_or_repo_file.split("/")
+    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[-1].endswith((".safetensors", ".bin", ".pt", ".pth", ".ckpt")):
+        return None
+    if len(parts) < 2:
+        return None
+    if len(parts) >= 3:
+        repo_id = "/".join(parts[:2])
+        filename = "/".join(parts[2:])
+    else:
+        repo_id = path_or_repo_file
+        filename = default_filename
+    from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
+
+    return hf_hub_download(repo_id=repo_id, filename=filename)

+
+def _load_flux_weights(dit: torch.nn.Module, pretrained_path: str, *, default_filename: str) -> None:
+    candidates = _candidate_weight_files(pretrained_path, default_filename=default_filename)
+    if not candidates:
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No FLUX DiT weights found under {pretrained_path}")
+
+    merged: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    for ckpt in candidates:
+        merged.update(_strip_known_prefixes(_load_state_dict(ckpt)))
+    # BFL checkpoints name the QK RMSNorm parameter `scale`; nn.RMSNorm uses `weight`.
+    merged = {
+        (
+            key[: -len(".scale")] + ".weight" if key.endswith(("query_norm.scale", "key_norm.scale")) else key
+        ): v
+        for key, v in merged.items()
+    }
+
+    result = dit.load_state_dict(merged, strict=False)
+    logger.info(
+        "Loaded FLUX DiT weights. "
+        f"files={len(candidates)} missing={len(result.missing_keys)} unexpected={len(result.unexpected_keys)}"
+    )
+    if result.missing_keys or result.unexpected_keys:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "FLUX DiT checkpoint does not match the native model: "
+            f"missing={result.missing_keys[:8]} unexpected={result.unexpected_keys[:8]}"
+        )
+
+
+def _build_flux_dit(params) -> Flux:
+    local_rank = os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK")
+    use_cuda = local_rank is not None and torch.cuda.is_available()
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{local_rank}") if use_cuda else torch.device("cpu")
+    init_seed = torch.cuda.initial_seed() if use_cuda else torch.initial_seed()
+    with torch.device(device):
+        dit = Flux(params)
+    # Constructor defaults consume RNG even though explicit TorchTitan
+    # initialization overwrites them. Reset so init_weights starts at the
+    # configured common model seed, as it does with TorchTitan meta creation.
+    if use_cuda:
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed(init_seed)
+    else:
+        torch.manual_seed(init_seed)
+    dit.init_weights()
+    return dit
+
+
+def build_flux_model(model_config: dict[str, Any]):
+    """
+    Build a FLUX model from the selected model preset.
+
+    `model_preset` is injected by the registry from `model.name` for Primus
+    configs such as `flux.1-dev` and `flux.1-schnell`.
+    """
+    cfg_dict: dict[str, Any] = dict(model_config.get("config", {}) or {})
+    float8_recipe = str(cfg_dict.get("float8_recipe") or "").strip().lower()
+    if float8_recipe not in {"", "tensorwise"}:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported FLUX float8_recipe={float8_recipe!r}; expected null or 'tensorwise'")
+    preset_name = str(model_config.get("model_preset") or cfg_dict.get("model_preset") or "flux.1-schnell")
+    preset = _FLUX_PRESET_ALIASES.get(preset_name.lower(), preset_name)
+
+    params_overrides = dict(cfg_dict.get("params", {}) or {})
+    if preset == "flux-dev":
+        params = flux_1_dev_params(**params_overrides)
+    elif preset == "flux-schnell":
+        params = flux_1_schnell_params(**params_overrides)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Unsupported FLUX model_preset="
+            f"{preset_name!r}; expected one of: 'flux.1-dev', 'flux.1-schnell'"
+        )
+    dit = _build_flux_dit(params)
+
+    pretrained_path = model_config.get("load_from_pretrained_path") or model_config.get("pretrained_path")
+    if preset == "flux-dev":
+        pretrained_path = materialize_pretrained("flux-dev", pretrained_path or "")
+    if pretrained_path:
+        logger.info(f"Loading FLUX DiT weights from {pretrained_path}")
+        default_filename = "flux1-dev.safetensors" if preset == "flux-dev" else "flux1-schnell.safetensors"
+        _load_flux_weights(dit, pretrained_path, default_filename=default_filename)
+
+    if float8_recipe:
+        try:
+            from torchao.float8 import (
+                CastConfig,
+                Float8LinearConfig,
+                ScalingType,
+                convert_to_float8_training,
+            )
+        except ImportError as exc:
+            raise ImportError("TorchAO is required for FLUX tensor-wise FP8 training") from exc
+
+        full_wgrad_fqns: list[str] = []
+        high_precision_wgrad_fqns: list[str] = []
+
+        def module_kind(module: torch.nn.Module, fqn: str) -> str | None:
+            if type(module) is not torch.nn.Linear:
+                return None
+            parts = fqn.split(".", 2)
+            if len(parts) != 3:
+                return None
+            if parts[0] == "double_blocks":
+                if parts[2] == "img_attn.qkv":
+                    return "qkv"
+                if parts[2] == "txt_attn.qkv":
+                    return "qkv"
+                if parts[2] in _FP8_DOUBLE_ATTN_PROJ_SUFFIXES:
+                    return "full"
+                if parts[2] in _FP8_DOUBLE_MLP_SUFFIXES:
+                    return "full"
+            if parts[0] == "single_blocks" and parts[2] in {"linear1", "linear2"}:
+                return "full"
+            return None
+
+        def full_wgrad_filter(module: torch.nn.Module, fqn: str) -> bool:
+            selected = module_kind(module, fqn) == "full"
+            if selected:
+                full_wgrad_fqns.append(fqn)
+            return selected
+
+        def high_precision_wgrad_filter(module: torch.nn.Module, fqn: str) -> bool:
+            selected = module_kind(module, fqn) == "qkv"
+            if selected:
+                high_precision_wgrad_fqns.append(fqn)
+            return selected
+
+        dit = convert_to_float8_training(
+            dit,
+            module_filter_fn=full_wgrad_filter,
+            config=Float8LinearConfig(
+                pad_inner_dim=False,
+                enable_fsdp_float8_all_gather=False,
+            ),
+        )
+        dit = convert_to_float8_training(
+            dit,
+            module_filter_fn=high_precision_wgrad_filter,
+            config=Float8LinearConfig(
+                cast_config_input_for_grad_weight=CastConfig(scaling_type=ScalingType.DISABLED),
+                cast_config_grad_output_for_grad_weight=CastConfig(scaling_type=ScalingType.DISABLED),
+                pad_inner_dim=False,
+                enable_fsdp_float8_all_gather=False,
+            ),
+        )
+        expected_full_count = len(dit.double_blocks) * 6 + len(dit.single_blocks) * 2
+        expected_high_precision_count = len(dit.double_blocks) * 2
+        if (
+            len(full_wgrad_fqns) != expected_full_count
+            or len(high_precision_wgrad_fqns) != expected_high_precision_count
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "FLUX FP8 converted "
+                f"{len(full_wgrad_fqns)} full-wgrad and "
+                f"{len(high_precision_wgrad_fqns)} high-precision-wgrad Linear modules; "
+                f"expected {expected_full_count} and {expected_high_precision_count}"
+            )
+        logger.info(
+            "Enabled TorchAO dynamic tensor-wise FP8 for "
+            f"{len(full_wgrad_fqns) + len(high_precision_wgrad_fqns)} FLUX block Linear modules; "
+            f"wgrad=FP8 for {len(full_wgrad_fqns)} and high precision for "
+            f"{len(high_precision_wgrad_fqns)} QKV modules"
+        )
+
+    encoder_cfg = dict(model_config.get("encoder", {}) or cfg_dict.get("encoder", {}) or {})
+    if preset == "flux-dev" and not encoder_cfg.get("autoencoder") and pretrained_path:
+        checkpoint = os.path.expanduser(str(pretrained_path))
+        root = checkpoint if os.path.isdir(checkpoint) else os.path.dirname(checkpoint)
+        ae_path = os.path.join(root, "ae.safetensors")
+        if os.path.isfile(ae_path):
+            encoder_cfg["autoencoder"] = ae_path
+        else:
+            logger.warning(f"FLUX autoencoder was not found next to {checkpoint}")
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    t5_encoder = None
+    clip_encoder = None
+    autoencoder = None
+    if encoder_cfg.get("t5_encoder"):
+        t5_encoder = HFEmbedder(
+            str(encoder_cfg["t5_encoder"]),
+            max_length=int(encoder_cfg.get("max_t5_length", 256)),
+            torch_dtype=dtype,
+        )
+    if encoder_cfg.get("clip_encoder"):
+        clip_encoder = HFEmbedder(
+            str(encoder_cfg["clip_encoder"]),
+            max_length=int(encoder_cfg.get("max_clip_length", 77)),
+            torch_dtype=dtype,
+        )
+    if encoder_cfg.get("autoencoder"):
+        ae_params = AutoEncoderParams(
+            resolution=int(encoder_cfg.get("resolution", 256)),
+            scale_factor=float(cfg_dict.get("autoencoder_scale_factor", 0.3611)),
+            shift_factor=float(cfg_dict.get("autoencoder_shift_factor", 0.1159)),
+        )
+        autoencoder = load_autoencoder(
+            str(encoder_cfg["autoencoder"]),
+            ae_params,
+            dtype=dtype,
+            sample_z=bool(encoder_cfg.get("sample_z", True)),
+        )
+
+    training_cfg = FluxTrainingConfig(
+        model_preset=preset,
+        trainable_modules=cfg_dict.get("trainable_modules", "dit"),
+        guidance=None if not params.guidance_embed else float(cfg_dict.get("guidance", 1.0)),
+        autoencoder_scale_factor=float(cfg_dict.get("autoencoder_scale_factor", 0.3611)),
+        autoencoder_shift_factor=float(cfg_dict.get("autoencoder_shift_factor", 0.1159)),
+    )
+    pipeline = FluxFlowMatchTrainPipeline(
+        FluxFlowMatchTrainPipelineConfig(
+            autoencoder_scale_factor=training_cfg.autoencoder_scale_factor,
+            autoencoder_shift_factor=training_cfg.autoencoder_shift_factor,
+            guidance=training_cfg.guidance,
+            timestep_sampling=str(
+                cfg_dict.get("timestep_sampling", "amdb_logit_normal" if preset == "flux-dev" else "uniform")
+            ),
+            shift=float(cfg_dict.get("shift", 3.0)),
+        )
+    )
+    model = FluxForTraining(
+        dit=dit,
+        train_pipeline=pipeline,
+        model_config=training_cfg,
+        autoencoder=autoencoder,
+        t5_encoder=t5_encoder,
+        clip_encoder=clip_encoder,
+        raw_config={
+            "model_config": model_config,
+            "flux_params": params.to_dict(),
+        },
+        trainable_modules=training_cfg.trainable_modules,
+    )
+    total_params, trainable_params = count_parameters(model)
+    logger.info(f"Built FLUX model: total={total_params:,} trainable={trainable_params:,}")
+    return model
